fields.headline: Adds $9,999.13 to DecoTech's camera contract at Skyline High and Rudsdale, raising it to $240,081.08
fields.summary: This change order has DecoTech Systems add 4 new cameras, repair 5 offline cameras and repair a damaged internet fiber cable for the Skyline High School and Rudsdale Sojourner Truth security project. It adds $9,999.13, raising the contract price from $230,081.95 to $240,081.08 including allowances. The $220,581.08 in the official text is that price less the $19,500 contingency allowance, not a reduction. It also extends the term by 159 days, to September 30, 2023, so part of the added time began before this vote.

23-1790.note: The new contract total was corrected from $220,581.08 (the price net of the $19,500 contingency allowance) to $240,081.08.
23-1790.sourceIssue: The official text says the agreement is reduced from $230,081.95 to $220.581.08, but the attached change order adds $9,999.13 for a price of $240,081.08; $220,581.08 is that price less the $19,500.00 contingency allowance.
